Note.title: Note
Note.description: A tactile typewriter note document synced across devices with typography preferences and progress metadata.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the note owner.

content.description: Full text content of the note.

wordCount.description: Number of words in the note.

charCount.description: Number of characters in the note.

wordGoal.description: Target word goal for the note.

fontId.description: Selected typewriter or editorial font identifier.

pinned.description: Whether the note is pinned at the top of the folio.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last modification (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

WritingSession.title: WritingSession
WritingSession.description: Completed writing session telemetry record for tracking writing statistics across devices.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the writer.

noteId.description: Identifier of the note edited during the session.

wordsWritten.description: Net words written during this session.

durationSeconds.description: Elapsed active writing time in seconds.

wpm.description: Average words per minute achieved during the session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when session was recorded (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).
